hotels.name: St Audries Park — stay with us
hotels.description: We would love you to stay at the venue itself. We are block-booking rooms for the night before and the night of the wedding at around £200 per room per night, with dinner and breakfast included. Tell us on the save-the-date form if you are interested and we will make sure we reserve enough.

hotels.name: The Windmill Inn
hotels.description: Our first choice if you would rather not stay at the venue. Mention the wedding when you book.

hotels.name: Placeholder Manor Hotel
hotels.description: Larger country hotel with a spa, ideal if you're making a weekend of it.

hotels.name: Budget Stays Placeholder
hotels.description: Reliable budget option near the motorway junction.

transport.name: By train
transport.description: Taunton is the nearest mainline station, about half an hour from the venue by taxi (placeholder — exact times to confirm).

transport.name: By taxi
transport.description: Local firms know the venue well — book your return journey in advance, especially after midnight.

transport.name: By car
transport.description: St Audries Park is on the A39 at West Quantoxhead, signposted from the main road. Postcode TA4 4DS for sat-nav.

parking: Free parking is available at the venue. Cars may be left overnight but must be collected by 10am the next morning.
